sentences.text: Hello, everyone. Welcome to the Slow English podcast. I am Emily. Today, we're going to talk about Astana. Astana is the capital city of Kazakhstan. It is a very modern city. People from different countries visit Astana. Astana has many tall buildings. The city is very clean.

Many people live and work here. Astana has a river. The river is called Ishem. People like to walk near the river. They can see birds and fish. In summer, people sit near the river. In winter, the river has ice.

People like to take pictures. Astana has many parks. In the parks, children play. People like to ride bicycles. People also like to take photos. Tourists like to see the city. Astana is very interesting.

The city has good restaurants. People can eat Kazakh food and food from other countries. You can drink tea or coffee in cafes. People are friendly. Everyone can enjoy Astana, part 2 history of Astana.
Astana is a young city. A long time ago, it was a small town. The name of the town was Atmolinsk. Many people lived there, but it was not very big.

In 1997, the city became the capital of Kazakhstan. The name changed to Astana. Astana means capital in Kazakh. The government built new buildings and streets. Many people came to live and work here. Now, Astana is very big. It has tall buildings, wide streets, and many parks.

The city is very modern. There are many schools, hospitals, and shopping centers. Astana has many monuments. One famous monument is the Botarek Tower. It is very tall. You can see the city from the top.
The history of Astana is interesting. People like to learn about the city. Astana is very important for Kazakhstan. It is the center of the country. People visit from other countries to see the city.

The city has changed a lot in a short time. Part 3. People in Astana. Many people live in Astana. The city has about 1 million people. People are from different regions of Kazakhstan. Some people come from other countries too.

People speak different languages. Kazakh is the main language. Russian is also very common. Some people speak English. People are friendly and helpful. Astana has many schools. Children go to school every day. They learn languages, math, and science.

Some children go to music and art classes. Many students study at universities in the city. People work in offices, schools, hospitals, and shops. Some people are artists or musicians. People like to help each other. Families are important in Astana.

In the city, you can meet many people in park, streets, and cafes. People like to meet friends and talk. Astana is a lively city with kind people. Part 4. Weather in Astana. Astana has very cold winters. In winter, it can be minus 30 degrees Celsius. People wear warm clothes, hats, and gloves.
They drink hot tea and soup to stay warm. In summer, the city is warm. The temperature can be 25 degrees Celsius.
People like to walk in the parks and ride bicycles. Many families go outside. Astana has four seasons.
Winter, spring, summer, and autumn. In spring, flowers bloom. People enjoy walking and taking photos.
In autumn, the leaves are yellow and red. It is very beautiful. People like to enjoy the weather.
In winter, children play in the snow. In summer, people have picnics.
The weather is different every season, but it is always interesting.
Astana is a city where people can enjoy nature and seasons. Tourists like to see the city in different seasons too.
Part 5. Buildings in Astana. Astana has many interesting buildings.
One famous building is by Terrecht Tower. It is very tall. You can see the city from the top.
Many tourists visit this tower every day. Another famous building is the Palace of Peace and Reconciliation.
It is a triangle shaped building. Many events happen here. People like the design.
Astana has many modern streets and shopping centers. People go shopping and eat in restaurants.
The city also has schools, hospitals, and government buildings. Astana is very clean.
Buildings are new and modern. The city looks beautiful. People like to take photos.
Tourists also enjoy walking around the city. Astana is a city with tall buildings and modern architecture.
You can see old and new styles together. It is a very interesting city.
Part 6. Transport in Astana. Astana has many buses and taxis.
People use buses to go to work or school. Buses are very comfortable. People also use taxis.
The city has wide roads and traffic lights. Many people walk on the streets too.
In summer, people like to ride bicycles. Astana has a modern airport.
People can fly to other cities and countries.
Trains and buses connect Astana to other parts of Kazakhstan.
People like to travel in the city and outside the city. Transport is very easy.
Tourists can go to parks, buildings, and museums.
The city is well organized. Astana is a city where people can move easily.
It is easy to travel in the city every day.
Part 7. Parks and nature. Astana has many parks.
People like to walk and play in the parks. Children can play on swings and slides.
Adults can sit and relax. The city has trees, flowers, and rivers.
People can enjoy nature. In winter, children can skate on ice in the parks.
In summer, people ride bicycles and have picnics.
Astana is very green in summer. It is a beautiful city.
People like to take photos of flowers and rivers. Nature is very important in Astana.
People like to protect trees and parks.
Everyone can enjoy clean air and green spaces.
Parks make the city very nice.
Part 8. Culture and events.
Astana has many cultural events.
People celebrate holidays like nullaries.
Norris is the new year in Kazakhstan.
People meet friends and family.
The city has theaters, museums, and concert halls.
People can watch music, dance, and plays.
Art is very important in the city.
Astana has modern art and traditional art.
People enjoy learning about culture.
Festivals and events happen every year.
Tourists like to visit these events.
Culture is very important in Astana.
People like to share art, music, and traditions.
The city is alive with colors, sounds, and celebrations.
Part 9. Food in Astana.
People in Astana like to eat Kazakh food.
One famous dish is beshbar mak.
It is meat with noodles.
People eat it with family.
People also eat bread, soup, and salads.
Restaurants in Astana have food from many countries.
People like different tastes and flavors.
Tea is very popular.
People drink tea every day.
They also drink coffee and juice.
Many cafes are in the city.
Food is part of the culture.
People meet friends and family to eat together.
Tourists like to try traditional food.
Astana is a city with good food.
Everyone can enjoy meals and drinks.
Part 10. Education in Astana.
Astana has many schools and universities.
Children start school at age 6.
Students learn languages, science, history, and art.
Many schools have sports and music classes.
Some students go to international schools.
Universities teach business, medicine, engineering, and arts.
Students come from all over Kazakhstan.
Some students come from other countries.
Education is very important in Astana.
People study hard and enjoy learning.
Children and students can have a good future.
Part 11. Sports in Astana.
People in Astana like sports.
Football is very popular.
People play football in parks and stadiums.
Ice hockey is also popular in winter.
Many children and adults play hockey.
There are many sports clubs in the city.
People also ride bicycles, swim, run, and do fitness.
Sports help people stay healthy.
Astana has many stadiums, gyms, and swimming pools.
People like to watch sports too.
Sports are an important part of life in the city.
Part 12. Goodbye from Astana.
Today we learned about Astana.
We learned about buildings, parks, food, people, and culture.
Astana is a modern and beautiful city.
Many people visit and live here.
It has tall buildings, rivers, parks, and interesting streets.
I am Emily.
Goodbye.
